method_library.use_when: The client wants something new built and launched: a venture, digital product, platform or new business model.

phases.name: Design

workstreams.name: Analyze
deliverables: Customer and market evidence on the hypotheses

workstreams.name: Plan
deliverables: Detailed plan for the pilot phase

phases.governance: Kick-off in week 1; mid-phase check-in; go/no-go on the pilot at phase end.

phases.name: Pilot

workstreams.name: Build
deliverables: First version launched to a small group of users

workstreams.name: Plan scale-up
deliverables: Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

phases.governance: Two steering workshops at about 30% and 70%; go/no-go on the next phase at phase end.

method_library.use_when: The client asks whether and how to enter a market, segment or geography, without building yet.

phases.name: Research

workstreams.name: Market attractiveness
deliverables: Market sizing and growth by segment

workstreams.name: Capability to win
deliverables: Gap assessment of the client's assets

phases.governance: Kick-off; steering workshop on findings near 60% when the phase is 8 weeks or more; findings sign-off at phase end.

phases.name: Design

workstreams.name: Entry options
deliverables: Entry options compared on agreed criteria

workstreams.name: Business case & roadmap
deliverables: Business case for the preferred option

phases.governance: Final decision meeting at phase end.

method_library.use_when: The client wants to change how it is organized or how work flows: structure, roles, processes, governance, shared services.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.governance: Kick-off; diagnostic readout at phase end.

phases.name: Design

workstreams.name: Detailed design
deliverables: Detailed design of the chosen model

phases.governance: Design workshop to choose the option near 40%; sign-off at phase end.

method_library.use_when: The client wants to cut cost, raise productivity or improve a measurable result in existing operations.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.governance: Kick-off; go/no-go on initiatives at phase end.

phases.name: Implementation

workstreams.name: Capability building
deliverables: Trained client team owning the initiatives

phases.governance: Steering workshop on wave results near 50%; handover decision at phase end.

method_library.use_when: The client wants to choose and put in place a system or software platform (ERP, CRM, data platform).

phases.name: Diagnostic

phases.name: Design
